description: Source code for a Slate.js-based editor plugin that manages component blocks within a document, including normalization, normalization, schema validation, and editor behavior customization.

methods.name: getAncestorComponentBlock
methods.description: Finds the nearest ancestor component block node in the editor's current selection.

methods.name: normalizeNodeWithinComponentProp
methods.description: Normalizes a node within a component property, handling inline marks, element normalization, and relationships.

methods.name: canSchemaContainChildField
methods.description: Checks if a given schema can contain a child field.

methods.name: doesSchemaOnlyEverContainASingleChildField
methods.description: Determines if a schema exclusively contains a single child field.

methods.name: findArrayFieldsWithSingleChildField
methods.description: Finds array fields within a schema that only contain a single child field.

methods.name: isEmptyChildFieldNode
methods.description: Checks if a component prop node is empty.

methods.name: withComponentBlocks
methods.description: Enhances an editor instance to handle component blocks, normalization, and custom insert/delete behavior.

methods.name: addMissingFields
methods.description: Adds missing fields to a value based on a schema, mainly for object schemas.
